hero.heading: Before your next decision, define the issue properly.

paragraphs.text: Financial decisions become difficult when the underlying issue, constraints, risks and available options have not yet been defined clearly. DNH's initial assessment helps clarify the type of issue, its urgency and its level of complexity before any specialist advisory work begins.

media.alt: A structured assessment of an important financial decision

why.heading: Before choosing a solution, we need to understand the real issue.
why.intro: A consultation request may appear straightforward, while the underlying issue may involve liquidity, risk, wealth structure, a business or a major financial decision. The assessment frames the issue before analysis begins.

statement.heading: A good answer begins with the right question.
statement.description: Before recommending a service, DNH seeks to understand what should be examined and whether the issue falls within an appropriate scope of work.
statement.comparison_after: Assessment = initial understanding of the issue and path

reasons.title: What is the real issue?
reasons.description: Before selecting a service, the decision or financial question that genuinely needs review must be made clear.

reasons.title: How complex and time-sensitive is it?
reasons.description: The time horizon, urgency and number of relevant variables can change the appropriate route.

reasons.title: What should happen next?
reasons.description: The initial assessment helps determine whether the next step should be an assessment, strategic consultation, executive briefing or another route.

outcome.title: The first outcome: a clearer view of the next step
outcome.description: The assessment indicates whether the matter calls for further review, strategic consultation, an executive briefing or a different path.

why.privacy_note: At this stage, DNH requests only what is needed to understand the objective, issue, complexity and initial fit—not confidential documents, full asset details or bank information.

process.heading: An assessment is more than a form; it is the beginning of a clearer decision process.
process.heading_highlight: the beginning of a clearer decision process.
process.intro: The first stage is not intended to produce an immediate recommendation. It clarifies fit, scope and complexity so that an appropriate professional route can be defined where needed.
process.start_note: The route for each matter is determined by its actual needs and suitability.

panel.heading: From understanding the issue to shaping a decision path.
panel.intro: Not every matter proceeds in the same way or at the same depth. The assessment allows the next step to follow the issue itself.
panel.note: Starting an assessment does not create a commitment to proceed; suitability is considered first.

steps.title: Initial understanding
steps.description: The decision, current situation and reason for the request are clarified at a preliminary level.

steps.title: Fit and scope
steps.description: Urgency, time horizon, complexity and alignment with DNH's scope are considered.

steps.title: Specialist session or briefing
steps.description: Where suitable, the matter may proceed to a specialist session, strategic consultation or executive briefing.

steps.title: Professional case review
steps.description: The issue is examined against the agreed scope, relevant information and decision variables.

steps.title: Structured decision view
steps.description: Options, scenarios and viable paths are brought together in a more structured view.

steps.title: Follow-up and review
steps.description: Where agreed and appropriate, the decision path may be revisited as circumstances evolve.

process.footer: The next step is to answer a short set of questions about your situation.

form.heading: A few focused questions to understand your situation.
form.intro: You do not need to prepare your complete financial information at this stage. The purpose is to understand the issue, your circumstances and the most appropriate initial route.
form.progress_description: The information in this form is used only for an initial understanding of the issue.
form.privacy_description: Bank details, identity documents and complete asset information are not required at this stage.

profile.title: Which situation best describes this assessment?
profile.description: Choose the closest option. It is used only to identify the most relevant initial route.

options.title: Individual / investor
options.description: For a personal financial decision or personal asset structure

options.title: Family / capital owners
options.description: For family wealth structure and shared financial decisions

options.title: Business owner
options.description: For decisions involving capital, liquidity or the business

options.title: Company / holding group
options.description: For financial structure, capital and organisational decisions

decision.title: What is the main subject of the decision?
decision.description: Choose the closest subject and briefly describe the current situation.
decision.situation_helper: In a few sentences, describe the situation as it stands today.
decision.situation_placeholder: For example: I hold several assets, but the balance between liquidity, risk and allocation is not clear...
decision.size_label: Approximate size of the capital or decision
decision.size_helper: Optional—only where relevant to the issue.

sizes.label: I prefer not to disclose this at this stage

timing.title: What is the time horizon and level of urgency?
timing.description: Timing can affect the type of review and the route that is most appropriate.
timing.horizon_helper: When are you likely to need a decision on this issue?

urgencies.title: Standard
urgencies.description: The issue matters, but there is no immediate time constraint.

urgencies.title: Important
urgencies.description: A decision is likely to be required within the coming months.

urgencies.title: Urgent
urgencies.description: A significant decision or event is approaching in the near term.

contact.title: How should we contact you about the next step?
contact.description: Only the details needed for the initial review are collected.
contact.summary_helper: What is the most important point we should understand before reviewing the request?
contact.summary_placeholder: Describe the decision or issue that currently carries the greatest uncertainty or importance...
contact.privacy_note: Please do not include bank details, passwords, identity documents, confidential contracts or sensitive information about other parties in this form.

success.title: Your initial information has been recorded.
success.description: The next stage is an initial review of the issue, its scope and the request's suitability. The process is explained in the next section.

privacy.heading: Understanding the issue does not require you to share everything.
privacy.heading_highlight: does not require you to share everything.
privacy.intro: The initial assessment is designed only to understand your situation, the issue and its preliminary suitability. More detailed information is considered only after the scope is clear and the information is genuinely necessary.
privacy.principle: The confidentiality of financial and commercial information is a core principle. Information is handled according to the agreed scope and the professional needs of the matter.

items.title: Basic details
items.description: Your name, client type and preferred contact method for the initial review.

items.title: Decision subject
items.description: The main issue, current situation and a concise description of what you are facing.

items.title: Timing and urgency
items.description: The decision horizon and the level of urgency that currently applies.

items.title: Approximate scope
items.description: Where relevant, a high-level indication of the size of the decision or capital involved.

not_needed.title: Please do not send at this stage

items.title: Complete bank information
items.description: Account numbers, login details, passwords or other sensitive banking information.

items.title: Unnecessary identity documents
items.description: Copies of identity documents that are not needed to understand the issue.

items.title: Confidential contracts
items.description: Business contracts and confidential documents are not required for the initial assessment.

items.title: Complete asset details
items.description: A complete list of assets, accounts and detailed financial information is not necessary yet.

items.title: Sensitive partner information
items.description: Private or confidential information about partners, shareholders or other people.

items.title: Extensive financial files
items.description: Full financial statements and large analytical files are not requested at the outset.

privacy.boundary: The principle is simple: request only the information genuinely needed for each stage.

trust_points.title: Minimum necessary information
trust_points.text: The initial form is for understanding the issue, not collecting a complete case file.

trust_points.title: Sensitive information comes later
trust_points.text: Only where professionally necessary and after the scope has been defined.

trust_points.title: Confidentiality as a principle
trust_points.text: Information is handled according to the engagement and the needs of the matter.

after_submission.heading: Your request has been submitted; the appropriate path is now reviewed.
after_submission.intro: Submitting an assessment does not place the matter into a predetermined service. The issue, scope, urgency and complexity are reviewed first so that any next step reflects the matter itself.

board.title: How the request is reviewed
board.note: Initial review before a service is identified

steps.title: The request is recorded
steps.description: The information entered in the assessment provides the initial basis for understanding the issue.

steps.title: Fit and scope are reviewed
steps.description: The decision subject, urgency, time horizon and initial level of complexity are considered.

steps.title: The next path is identified
steps.description: Where there is a suitable fit, an appropriate form of professional conversation or review is proposed.

board.paths_title: Where appropriate, the next stage may take different forms.

paths.title: Specialist consultation
paths.description: For an issue that requires deeper discussion, clearer scope and professional review.

paths.title: Executive briefing
paths.description: For a focused matter requiring synthesis at executive, owner or key decision-maker level.

board.caveat: If the matter does not fall within an appropriate scope of work, the assessment will not necessarily lead to a meeting or advisory engagement.
board.principle: Clarify the issue and fit first; determine the form of engagement second.

reassurance.title: Request recorded
reassurance.text: The assessment is the starting point for understanding the issue.

reassurance.title: Suitability reviewed
reassurance.text: Scope, complexity and the most appropriate initial path are considered.

reassurance.title: No predetermined promise
reassurance.text: The form of any engagement is not assumed before the initial review.

after_submission.return_prompt: Have not submitted the form yet?

question_cta.label: Have another question about the process?

contact.heading: Still unsure where to begin? Start with the issue itself.
contact.intro: You do not need to know in advance which service, meeting or route is right for your situation. If an important financial decision needs a clearer view, the assessment is the place to begin.
contact.action_title: When you are ready, begin with the initial assessment.

contact_link.label: Have a general question? Contact DNH

contact.closing: The appropriate route is identified after the issue and its initial fit are understood—not before.
